cell.label: Mild disease involving <20% of body surface area?
Start topical steroids alone or with one of following: calcipotriene or tazarotene. Effective?
Use topical steroid as pulse therapy on weekend and other agent during the week.
Start clobetasol ointment and refer for narrow-band UV therapy. Effective?
Refer for methotrexate, acitretin, biologic agent, or cyclosporine.
Taper clobetasol to weekends only and continue UV for 4 months.
